measures.title: Bibb County school district senior homestead exemption
measures.summary: A special election on a local Act of the General Assembly. It would provide a homestead exemption from Bibb County school district property taxes for educational purposes of $17,000 of the assessed value for residents aged 65 to 74, $32,000 for those aged 75 to 84, and the full assessed value for residents 85 and older.
measures.yesMeans: Homeowners 65 and older would get a larger exemption from Bibb County school property taxes, rising with age, with a full exemption at 85 and older.
measures.noMeans: The Act is not approved and this school tax exemption does not take effect.
